bias: 'I've been pounding the table about 7815-7820 for weeks — the reclaim that opens new highs, but the market is weak below there.' Right after the bell, news of Vance reaching out to Iran ripped futures before earnings were even out; 7815-7820 rejected firmly (AH high 7819.5), then earnings disappointments followed through all the way to today's low. NQ didn't quite make 30210-30237 (AH high 30178) and is now below today's low. 'This rejection has potential to put in a durable swing high meant to make new lows, but bulls have probably one shot to negate it tomorrow.' He is short with malicious intent and will tip his hat to bulls above 7815-7820 — but will stay objective and can day-trade long against it if indicated. YM is trying to bid to offset NQ weakness.
wildcard: If this was part of the trap setup, both ES and NQ should open on a true gap down. 7750-7752 (extended to include today's low 7751.5) is the clear edge of this week's upper distribution — it just traded and held as he wrote; bulls are completely fine as long as it holds, inclusive of a LBAF. NQ's equivalent is 754-787 (the 5 pm close sat right there); bulls in some trouble below now that after hours traded through much of Tuesday's structure. Yesterday had key areas all the way down to Monday's 7739.5 high.
